stages.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a single exquisitely art-directed full-bleed 16:9 desktop screenshot concept for GLAZE, a contemporary digital ceramic art exhibition. Landscape 2560x1440 or larger. NO browser chrome, NO cards, NO panels, NO grids. The photograph occupies every pixel. The visual language is the finest real museum object photography combined with Swiss editorial typography and dramatically bold crop. This is scene 03, COBALT. One extraordinarily tactile cobalt ceramic ring vase dominates center-right, 68% of frame width; a thick, hollow handmade moon-ring vessel with a believable small open neck at the very top, not a generic mathematical donut. Its ring wall is thick and slightly organically irregular, it sits with a solid foot on the floor. It enters from right and extends below the bottom frame, monumental scale, with its top around 13% down from top. Real deep electric cobalt glaze pooling into dark midnight blue, very subtle throwing imperfections, finely broken specular sheen, narrow pale softbox reflection sliding down its curved shoulder, visible fired ceramic material, not plastic and not a CGI toy. Single saturated but soft blue-gray studio cyclorama, restrained directional soft light from upper left, heavy tactile contact shadow and dark inside the ring opening, realistic glaze reflection, no accent decorative items. Left 32% of frame gives considered negative space. Giant light-ivory grotesk 'COBALT' spans the middle behind the vessel, partial letter occlusion by vessel, impressive editorial proportion. Small warm white copy at upper-left middle reading exactly 'A deeper kind\nof blue.' in two lines, delicately set sans serif. Header in very tiny tracked pale ivory grotesk: 'GLAZE' top-left, 'COLOR FIRED INTO FORM' top-center, 'Index +' top-right. Footer tiny pale ivory at lower-left: '03 / 07' then 'COBALT'; bottom-right tiny 'Light held in blue.' No other UI. Render photograph and typography extraordinarily cleanly. Rich vivid blue object, deep blue-gray background, warm ivory typography; refuse cheap neon, overdone gradient backgrounds, generic 3D metallic torus, impossible geometry, stock photo aesthetic, painterly image, traditional ornament, watermark.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the approved GLAZE COBALT web scene concept. Make its clean PRODUCTION PHOTOGRAPH, preserving exactly the existing giant ring-vase geometry, shape, edge positions, glaze material, highlights, shadows, blue-gray studio, crop, aspect ratio, and color. Remove ALL typography and ALL UI completely: header GLAZE / COLOR FIRED INTO FORM / Index +, left subtitle, giant COBALT letters in front and behind vessel (including visible letters through ring opening and giant T on right), footer numbers/names/caption. Restore exactly natural photographic material under every removed letter. Where text overlays the object, seamlessly reconstruct matching cobalt glazed pottery with the existing lighting; where behind object or through hole, restore matching blue-gray cyclorama. Keep the giant ring vase identical: actual small open top neck, dark hollow ring, realistic rough blue glaze pooling, light rectangular specular reflection, organic fired imperfections. Do not change camera angle, do not resize or shift object, do not alter scene lighting or saturation, do not create a new subject. Landscape 16:9, highest available resolution, ideally 2560x1440 or larger. Final image must contain absolutely NO text, letters, logos, icons, UI or watermarks. This is only the photographic plate. No blur, color overlays, extra props or borders.
